name: Binary Tree In-Order Traversal
description:
Given the root of a binary tree, return the in-order traversal of its nodes' values.

In an in-order traversal, the left subtree is visited first, then the root node, and finally the right subtree.
hints: In-order order is: Left -> Root -> Right.
A helper function `traverse(node *TreeNode)` with recursion is the most natural approach.
Base case: if node is nil, return. Otherwise, traverse(node.Left), record node.Val, traverse(node.Right).
